erratum.interpretation: The no-target and scrambled controls undermine targeted-control/semantic-reframing attribution. Counts stay unchanged; scope is envelope fragility under long imperative out-of-distribution instructions.

matching: Within a run, every arm shares task and seed with none; reported policy seed, checkpoint, horizon and original instruction are checked. Unrecorded runtime conditions remain unknown.
outcomeMeaning: Publisher reported success is an envelope-exit flag, not clean task success or targeted object control. The reader checks native decision flags for consistency, without evaluating actions or the safety predicate.

population.episodes: Every published task/seed/arm record of each run; runs remain separate. Not-applicable records remain visible and outside measured denominators.
population.residualDependence: Tasks share policy, simulator and benchmark. Whole-task resampling keeps within-task repeats and all arms paired but does not remove dependence between tasks.
population.tasks: The ten published LIBERO-Object tasks; selected benchmark tasks, with shared policy and simulator. No random sample of an external task population is established.

holmFamilies.control: All five non-baseline arms, including four harmless-variation controls; this is broader than the README phrasing.

publisherIntervalMethod.relation: Retained as publisher analysis, distinct from this exact joint paired count distribution. Neither interval is certified coverage.
publisherIntervalMethod.source: aggregate.json and src/provael/scoring/paired.py at the publication pin
